notes:
BUU v3.2.0 - the one-path rebuild: one engine, zero duplicated code paths.

Every job in BUU now has exactly ONE implementation. The full-code audit found the same work done in up to 8 drifted copies; this release consolidates all of it and deletes every dead path so nothing stale can ever run again.

What you will notice:
- Setup/teardown flows attached to a run use the SAME engine as everything else now: {{TODAY}}/{{RUNDATE}} tokens work in them (they silently resolved to BLANK before), elements inside PestPac iframes are found, and a failed setup shows WHY in the run status line instead of failing invisibly.
- The pre-launch checker matches the run exactly: wrong-case tokens ({{account number}} vs Account Number) get flagged at Stage with a "did you mean" hint instead of silently typing blank values into PestPac; tokens in after-click and file-upload fields are checked too; {{TODAY-1}} and {{RUNDATE}} no longer falsely flag as missing columns.
- The flows folder finally stays clean: the installer no longer ships flat-root duplicates (22 were riding along in the bundle), and the seeder no longer resurrects files the app just cleaned up. One boot after this install, C:\BUU\flows tidies itself for good. Flows still sync to every computer via updates, exactly as before (updates ADD missing flows; local copies always win).
- The auto-tuned worker count (lastGoodWorkers) now saves into the flow file BUU actually reads - it was landing in the stale flat duplicate, so the learned optimum never took effect.
- Updates install themselves properly now: the updater verifies the installer actually launched, falls back to the shell if not, refuses to close BUU on a failed launch, and writes updates\update.log so any failure is diagnosable. THIS update is the last manual install - 3.1.7 carries the broken launcher.
- Spreadsheets are read by ONE parser everywhere: the row count at staging is exactly the set of rows the workers run (the old worker-side CSV split broke on quoted commas), and the import preview matches the run byte-for-byte.
- Startup no longer fetches a spreadsheet library from a CDN (it was completely unused); installers are slimmer (unused csv-parse dependency removed).

Under the hood: once-flow runner template retired (per-job/global setup-teardown runs through the pool worker engine, dedicated seat + verified logout preserved, no-retry by design); ONE token module (engine/tokens.js) shared by the engine, pause preview, sweeper, and builder checker; ONE child-process spawn scaffold (creds/env/temps/NDJSON/cleanup); ONE login-screen probe and ONE license-page reader (engine/login.js); ONE spreadsheet module (engine/rows.js); textedit step ghosts, phantom phase-pip UI, the no-op live log and its 23 call sites, never-shown buttons, and the rest of the dead-code cluster deleted.
